The issue is:
1. Original pod had image "nginx:latets" (typo - misspelled "latest")
2. This caused ImagePullBackOff errors

- One pod (webapp-5998749fd7-s2pkq) is running but appears to have gotten the correct "nginx:latest" image through some mechanism
